      public net.minecraft.core.Holder<net.minecraft.world.damagesource.DamageType> build()
      Builds the DamageType.

      This method returns an intrusive holder that must be properly added to the registry. RegistryProviderBase does this automatically if the result is stored in a public, non-static field inside the provider.
